name: create_sdk_key
description:
Create an SDK key for a project's feature flags, for a given key type (server, mobile, or client) and environment, with an optional label. The returned key is a credential; handle it as a secret.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} flags sdk-keys add --type {type} --environment {environment} --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
